_comment: task.testing.021: what was really executed, and what was not, for the areas Python tests cannot settle alone.
executed: each evidence path is an executed, passed record or a live run that passed.
not_executed: shown as UNCONFIRMED. No evidence is claimed; independent_tests cover only the local side,
and reason says what was not run. tests/test_verification_scope.py enforces these rules.

external_services.scope: Create one labelled issue in this repository's GitHub Issues: normal, replay, lost reply, crash before send, target check.
A real GitHub rate-limit reply followed by one resend.
external_services.reason: A live run cannot force GitHub to rate-limit; only the fake destination produces that reply.

external_services.scope: A redirect returned by the real GitHub API.
external_services.reason: GitHub did not redirect during the live run; redirects were tested against local HTTP servers only.

external_services.scope: Any external destination other than GitHub Issues (for example payment providers).
external_services.reason: No adapter exists. contracts/github_issue_destination.json is the only destination contract.

external_services.scope: A real model provider (network model API).
external_services.reason: Only the offline fixture (model_mock.OfflineResponses) is implemented; no request leaves the host.

official_mcp.scope: Official Python MCP SDK 2.3.0 client and server over standard input and output, with a hash-locked dependency set.

The official conformance suite (modelcontextprotocol/conformance 0.2.0-alpha.12, commit 96a6f94) against the stdio server, every scenario upstream applies to each protocol version the SDK supports (2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25, 2026-07-28): ping, tools/list, tools/call text and error results pass, and every exchanged frame passed the upstream wire-schema validator. CI compares each new run with this record.
MCP over the Streamable HTTP transport, and remote authorization.
official_mcp.reason: The server is served over standard input and output only; HTTP here is the separate jobs API.

official_mcp.scope: Official conformance scenarios that could not probe this server: 27 that the upstream harness runs only through an HTTP URL (among them the 2026-07-28 stateless _meta and discovery probes, sessions, SSE, headers and DNS rebinding) and 6 that need tools of upstream's reference server.
official_mcp.reason: They are recorded per version in evidence/mcp-conformance/results.json with their category in evidence/mcp-conformance/applicability.json, but their checks did not run against this stdio server, so nothing they test is confirmed here.

durable_records.scope: SQLite ledger recovery after a process is killed (SIGKILL) mid-request, mid-lease and mid-transaction.
Operating-system crash or power loss (as opposed to a killed process).
durable_records.reason: Only process death is simulated; SQLite's and the file system's durability after power loss is relied on.

durable_records.scope: A full disk or I/O errors while the ledger commits.
durable_records.reason: No test injects ENOSPC or EIO into SQLite.

durable_records.scope: Ledger backup and restore without re-executing operations.
durable_records.reason: Planned as task.operations.016; not part of the testing phase.

durable_records.scope: Long-duration (soak) operation and the ledger on a network or multi-host file system.
durable_records.reason: The stress test is finite and local (evidence/multiprocess_stress.json is marked not a soak test); multi-host storage is out of scope.
